meta.name: Follow up on overdue invoices with OpenAI, Gmail and Google Sheets

name: AI Accounts Receivable Follow-Up — Guardrailed Gmail + Google Sheets

parameters.content:
## AI Accounts Receivable Follow-Up — Guardrailed Gmail + Google Sheets

### How it works

This workflow runs every morning to review accounts receivable invoices in Google Sheets and decide whether a follow-up email should be sent. For each eligible invoice, it checks Gmail thread history, applies guardrails to avoid duplicate or poorly timed messages, uses OpenAI to classify the correspondence, and then either sends a deterministic reminder, defers, flags for human review, or reconciles an already-sent stage. It writes the resulting state back to Google Sheets and loops until all invoices are processed.

### Setup steps

- Configure the schedule trigger for the desired daily run time and timezone.
- Connect Google Sheets credentials and set the invoice spreadsheet, sheet/tab, and column mappings used by the read and update nodes.
- Connect Gmail credentials with permission to read thread history and send reminder emails from the intended mailbox.
- Connect OpenAI credentials and verify the classification prompt/model settings match the desired AR decision policy.
- Review the Configuration code node for thresholds, stage rules, sender details, and any spreadsheet field names before activating the workflow.

### Customization

Adjust eligibility timing, follow-up stages, the 72-hour conversation guardrail, AI classification criteria, and deterministic email templates to match your collections policy.

## Schedule and settings

Starts the workflow on the daily schedule and loads runtime configuration such as policy thresholds, sheet fields, and follow-up settings.

## Load eligible invoices

Reads the invoice tracker from Google Sheets and determines which invoice records are eligible for follow-up processing.

## Invoice loop control

Iterates through eligible invoices one at a time and provides the completion endpoint once all batches have been processed.

## Collect thread context

Retrieves Gmail history for the current invoice, builds a normalized thread context, and checks whether the current follow-up stage has already been sent.

## Apply timing safeguards

Handles non-AI guardrails by reconciling an already-sent stage or deferring invoices with recent customer conversation activity.

## Classify correspondence

Uses OpenAI to evaluate the email context, safely parses the AI output, and branches based on whether the AI recommends sending a reminder.

## Send reminder email

Builds a deterministic follow-up message, sends it through Gmail, and prepares the state update for a successfully sent reminder.

## Handle AI alternatives

Processes AI outcomes that should not send automatically, either preparing a human review state or recording an AI-based defer decision.

## Persist invoice state

Updates the invoice tracker in Google Sheets with the result of the current invoice decision, then returns control to the batch loop.

values.content:
You classify accounts-receivable email context. You DO NOT decide whether an invoice is overdue, which reminder stage applies, or whether business rules allow a send. Those decisions are deterministic upstream.

Return JSON only with exactly these keys: decision, reason, confidence, reference_sentence.

decision must be one of SEND, DEFER, HUMAN.
- SEND: no concrete correspondence reason blocks a routine reminder.
- DEFER: the client says payment was sent, gives a future payment date, is waiting on requested invoice/payment information, or there is another clear short-term reason to wait.
- HUMAN: amount/service/contract dispute, legal threat, chargeback, serious financial hardship, contradictory evidence, or anything unsafe to automate.

reference_sentence is optional and must be a single factual sentence safe to put in an email. It may reference only something explicitly supported by the supplied email history. Never invent payment promises, dates, amounts, names, or explanations. If there is no safe reference, return an empty string. confidence must be 0 to 1.
